afd.snippet: 000 FXUS65 KGJT 082351 AFDGJT Area Forecast Discussion National Weather Service Grand Junction CO 551 PM MDT Tue Sep 8 2026 .KEY MESSAGES... - Isolated showers, maybe a quick storm, will remain possible over the San Juans and along the Continental Divide this afternoon. - High temperatures will be around 5 to 10 degrees above seasonal norms through most of the week. && .DISCUSSION... Issued at 121

fwf.snippet: .DISCUSSION... Drier air moves in today, and will remain in place through at least Thursday. Below threshold relative humidity values are forecast during the afternoon and evening, particularly tomorrow and Thursday. Afternoon wind gusts look to be marginal at most, but localized critical fire weather conditions are expected to occur in the Four Corners region and along some areas of the Divide. M
